description: Defines the JsonApiDocumentTopLevel class representing the top-level structure of a JSON:API document in Drupal, including properties for data, meta, links, includes, and omissions, along with constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: JsonApiDocumentTopLevel
classes.description: Represents the top-level structure of a JSON:API document, managing data, meta, links, includes, and omissions, with methods to access these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the JsonApiDocumentTopLevel object with data, includes, links, and optional meta, asserting correct types and merging data as needed.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the main data or error collection of the JSON:API document.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Returns the collection of top-level links.

methods.name: getOmissions
methods.description: Returns the resources to be omitted from the response.
